before.test/profile_test.exs:
ExUnit.start()
defmodule ProfileTest do
  use ExUnit.Case, async: true
  test "normalizes profile names" do
    for {input, expected} <- [{" ALICE ", "alice"}, {" Bob", "bob"}, {"", ""}] do
      assert Profile.name(input) == expected
    end
  end
end
